dog.description_text:
Beechnut is a little wild child with a whole lot of love to give! This adorable kitten is full of energy, always ready to play, explore, and get into a little mischief. But underneath all that spunk is an incredibly sweet and affectionate girl who loves attention and cuddles. Beechnut is the perfect mix of playful and loving, and she’s sure to keep her future family entertained!

Beechnut is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on vaccinations. Come meet her at our Manhattan Adoption Center, no appointment needed! If she’s at our Wantagh location or in foster care, please submit an adoption application online at www.bideawee.org.
